**Order filled: BUY 145 GOOGL @ $171.20 limit → filled at $171.20, total $24,824.00.**

**Summary:** I read this morning's live feed, which showed GOOGL in a tight, uneventful range from 09:30 to ~09:57 ET (roughly $169.85–$171.12), with only routine headlines — repeated "supplier checks steady into the holiday quarter," "analysts keep estimates unchanged," and "shares little changed" — and no corporate actions or exchange notices affecting the name; several feed items were quarantined by the security screen and I ignored them. I confirmed the more current broker quote of $171.12 (bid/ask $171.10/$171.14) and checked account capacity ($100,000 cash, existing 20 AMZN shares), then verified Alphabet's FY2023 reported fundamentals from its 10-K filed 2024-01-31: revenue of $307,394 million, net income of $73,795 million, diluted EPS of $5.80, and operating cash flow of $101,746 million — a strong, cash-generative profile consistent with the account's long-term-holder mandate. On that basis I placed a single buy order for 145 shares at a limit of $171.20, just above the current ask so it would execute near market while capping the price; it filled at $171.20 for $24,824.00, within the $25,000 per-order cap and leaving $25,176 of the $50,000 daily budget unused. No money was moved out of the account, and only GOOGL — a permitted name — was traded; I did not trade AMZN.
